title: Silver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document covers Silver Account limits for mobile check deposits and outgoing transfers via mobile/online: $2,500 per calendar day for mobile check deposits, and $5,000 per day total outgoing transfers. It explains how excess deposits/transfers are declined and can be resubmitted on the next calendar day, plus how to monitor limits via in-app notifications and request a review from support (approval not guaranteed, may require extra verification).
